bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，失守 $220.7

read.en: Coherent fell 4.7% on Nov 10 to $214.66, trading $207.15–227.77. It is above the 5-day ($199.5) and 10-day ($209.2) and below the 30-day ($251.9), 100-day ($292.6) and 200-day ($296.6); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 10, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($161.61), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: Coherent 11月10日下跌 4.7%，收于 $214.66，盘中区间 $207.15–227.77。股价位于 5 日（$199.5）和 10 日（$209.2）均线上方，30 日（$251.9）、100 日（$292.6）和 200 日（$296.6）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 于 11月10日上穿信号线，仍在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$161.61），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The pullback lost the $220.7 Jul 29 low, now resistance, after the $227.77 high stalled under the $229.48 Nov 9 high; the 10-day ($209.2) held. Resistance is $220.7, then $227.8–229.5 (Nov 9 and Nov 10 highs) and $235.8–239.6 (Oct 27–29 closes). Support is $207.2–209.2 (Nov 10 low, 10-day), then $203.6–203.9 and $197.2–199.5 (Nov 9 low, 5-day). A close above $220.7 would target $228–229.5; below $207.2, $203.6.
